question: What do Samsung Galaxy S10 users say about screen quality and everyday performance?
answer:
One reviewer said the clarity of the Galaxy S10 screen is marvelous and that the phone is comfortable to hold and use. [f13bc4cad828_0]
Another reviewer described the S10's resolution as great but reported that the screen flickers every now and then, which led them to return it. [d984310eb2eb_0]
A reviewer upgrading from a Galaxy S7 to the S10 saw a noticeable difference in performance. [a025d0475c57_0]
One reviewer called the S10 quite fast when upgrading from an S6. [c4bc0d0e3983_0]
Another reviewer said the S10 powers on very quickly and runs smoothly. [d984310eb2eb_0]
A reviewer who had the phone around five days said it seems to be functioning at peak performance. [7b5b44f5182f_0]

chunks.text: Good phone. Everything is great about the phone if you're a regular Samsung user. I went from a Galaxy S7 to this S10 and have seen a noticeable difference in performance. The only thing I'm bummed about is a close-up picture setting that was on the S7 but not on the S10. Despite that, the camera is of excellent quality and has a fast response.
Galaxy S10. Works and looks brand new, no problems so far!
Samsung s10. So far its been great. Very lightweight. Battery life seems good. Quite fast upgrading from s6.

Longer battery life!. I like my Galaxy S10. Have not used the fingerprint reader or face recognition but the longer battery life is a big bonus. The clarity of the screen is marvelous, it is comfortable to hold and use. I really like it.
samsung s10. Good phone. It's a good phone
S10. Phone works well, battery dies a little quicker than my A50 but all features works and look like brand new.

Galaxy s10 128 gig top quality like new thank you. Thank you for the Samsung Galaxy S10 I read some reviews and I guess they where from a while back but this company has it together I received a quality product activated service today through Verizon and I have had it around 5 days seems to be functioning at peak performance I did select Verizon carrier the phone is a sprint phone but no problems if your hesitant or over thinking it don't good quality company ill use them again thank you again

The best phone for its price!. Overall, the Samsung Galaxy s10 is an amazing phone. A 6.1 inch screen and very lightweight at 5.54oz. Resolution is great, it powers on very quickly and runs smoothly! My only problem was, the screen flickers every now and then. So I decided that I would return it. According to the UPS tracking number, my return has been delivered since June 1, 2020. Today is June 23rd, I have not yet received my refund. I have tried calling Amazon, but just a recording message only. I have never experienced such a long period for a refund, please help!
S10 Samsung galaxy seems new to me.. Looks and acts like new. I'm happy with my new used phone.
